notes: Owens & Minor's 2021 10-K reports about 6,900 US and 10,400 non-US teammates at year-end 2021, headquartered in Mechanicsville, VA. Owens & Minor Distribution, Inc. is the parent's operating subsidiary named as a borrower in its credit agreement.

Polytech America's site (https://polytech-america.com/) calls it a member of the Toyo Seikan Group, with its plant at 3021 Saratoga Ave. SW, Canton, OH; the exact ownership share was not found. Toyo Seikan lists 18,830 consolidated employees in 2025 (18,419 in 2018 per Wikipedia), so it was well over 5,000 in 2021.

Satco is a family-owned air cargo equipment maker headquartered in El Segundo, CA, per JobsOhio and its own site; no parent company. Size rests on Form 5500 counts of 479 (2019) and 438 (2023) participants, which include former employees, so 100-499 is likely but could be near the 500 line.

JobsOhio's 2019 release says Tigerpoly is a wholly owned subsidiary of Osaka-based Tigers Polymer and had 395 Grove City workers. Tigers Polymer's site lists 1,786 consolidated employees in 2026 (Japanese Wikipedia gives 1,844 in 2016), so the 2021 figure is inferred to sit in the same bucket.

parent: Würth Group (Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG)
notes: A Würth Elektronik release says ICS (Niedernhall, Germany) has a US subsidiary and that Würth Elektronik, about 7,300 employees, is part of the Würth Group (87,047 employees in 2023 per Wikipedia). The Vandalia entity is assumed to be that US subsidiary from its name; no page tying it to Vandalia was found.

Butech Bliss's site says Butech started in Salem, OH in the mid-1980s, is led by president John Buta, and runs three Salem plants; no outside parent was found. Size rests on Form 5500 counts of about 290 to 296 participants and 270 jobs retained in JobsOhio's report.

Component Hardware Group is a Lakewood, NJ maker of foodservice and industrial hardware operating since 1981, per its site; no parent or PE owner was found. Size rests on Form 5500 counts of 161 (2019) and 107 (2023) participants, which include former employees, so it may sit near the 100 line.

Dowa THT's site (https://www.dowa-tht.com/about/) says DOWA THT America was established in 1997 under DOWA Thermotech, the heat treatment business of the DOWA group, in Bowling Green, OH. DOWA Holdings lists 11,577 consolidated employees in 2026 (6,400 in 2018 per Wikipedia), so it was over 5,000 in 2022.

Essilor Laboratories of America is the US prescription lab arm of Essilor, which merged with Luxottica in 2018 to form EssilorLuxottica (203,791 employees in 2025 per Wikipedia). The ownership link rests on the name and its Form 5500 sponsor record (Dallas-area, dba Bell Optical); no page tying the Columbus lab to the parent was fetched.

parent: Hematite Manufacturing (Ontario); acquired by The Woodbridge Group in January 2022
notes: Hematite is a family-founded Ontario auto parts maker (Guelph, Brantford, Englewood OH, Mexico) that filed for creditor protection in 2020, and Rubber News reported Woodbridge Group bought it in January 2022, mid-grant-year; no worldwide headcount was found for either owner. The bucket is a best guess from a four-plant footprint and the 100-job Englewood plant.

parent: MCG Family of Pennsylvania Limited Partnership (owner not identified)
notes: Unresolved: the 990 lists 14 Technology Way, Steubenville, and an economic development grant, but Google News, EDGAR full-text, the JobsOhio sitemap, and the Herald-Star turned up no operating company or owner. The PA state and bucket are guesses from the name and grant type, not from a source.

Howmet's 2021 10-K reports about 19,900 employees worldwide, headquartered in Pittsburgh; a Howmet plan amendment filed with that 10-K (exhibit10g1.htm) covers RMI Titanium Company, LLC's Niles, Ohio workers, confirming Howmet ownership. RMI's own 5500 shows 564 to 972 participants.

Rocky Brands' 2021 10-K reports about 2,825 employees at December 31, 2021, with about 2,100 in manufacturing plants mostly outside Ohio; it is a public company headquartered in Nelsonville, OH. Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/Rocky_Brands) says it was founded in Nelsonville in 1932.

parent: TenCate Advanced Armour Holding (now Integris Composites)
notes: Defense Daily reported that London PE firm Agilitas bought the Netherlands-based TenCate Advanced Armour from Royal TenCate in March 2021, with more than 300 employees across the Netherlands, Denmark, France and the US. It was renamed Integris Composites in 2023.

V&S Schuler's site says Voigt & Schweitzer bought the Charles E. Schuler Company (founded in Newark, OH in 1939) after it moved to Canton in 1988; V&S Galvanizing is headquartered in Columbus with 9 US plants plus five Schuler companies. No headcount was found, so the bucket is a guess from that footprint; V&S appears tied to Germany's Voigt family ZINQ group (2,000 employees in Europe), which was not confirmed.

JBT's 2022 10-K says it bought Bevcorp, LLC in 2022 (September 1 per its XBRL tags), inside the FY2023 grant year, and reports about 7,200 employees worldwide with headquarters in Chicago. Before the sale Bevcorp was an independent Ohio beverage-equipment maker; its prior owner was not checked.

parent: Evans Food Group Ltd. (Benestar Brands, now Monarca Food Solutions)
notes: The company history says Evans was founded in Chicago in 1947, bought Savory Foods (OH) in 1987, and was acquired by PE firm Wind Point Partners in 2016, adding plants in CA and GA. Size rests on Form 5500 counts of 409 (2019) and 570 (2023) participants, which include former employees, so it may sit near the 500 line.

Sandvik's site says the group has about 42,000 employees, and Wikipedia gives about 41,000 in 2024; its US unit's Form 5500 (Sandvik, Inc.) shows 4,853 participants in 2023. The Ohio link is likely Cleveland's Allied Construction Products, which Sandvik bought in 2021 per trade press, though that was not confirmed for this grant.

JobsOhio's December 2021 release lists 38 jobs retained and 40 to be added at the Cincinnati freight broker, and FreightWaves says it was founded in Cincinnati in 2012. Chicago's Redwood Logistics bought Stridas in March 2026, after the grant years.

Tessenderlo Kerley is the North American unit of Brussels-based, Euronext-listed Tessenderlo Group, which now reports more than 7,000 employees; Wikipedia gives 4,547 at end-2017, so the 2023 figure may sit near the 5,000 line. The US unit's Form 5500 shows 597 participants in 2023.
